how: Lot count in every 512-px Leaflet cell (the exact web-mercator grid esri-leaflet requests) across each source's county, by returnCountOnly. `busiest` is the largest cell at that zoom; `cap` is the layer's maxRecordCount. The outline layer draws ONE request per cell with no paging, so a cell over the cap is silently truncated. Regenerate with ui-audit/scan-outline-density.mjs.

tn_statewide.note: 16 sampled city cores (Johnson City, Kingsport, Jackson, Maryville, Cleveland, Bristol, Gatlinburg, ...) on a 3x3 cell scan — not an exhaustive grid; the 86 counties' densest named place also passed in the sweep (max 800)
